outcome: Perinatal outcomes (need for Cesarean section, Apgar score, NICU admission, perinatal death)
cohort: 50 women with normal singleton pregnancies and 50 women with IUGR pregnancies (expected birth weight <10th percentile).
finding: Doppler velocimetry of the umbilical artery is highly sensitive in detecting IUGR and predicting adverse perinatal outcomes in small for gestational age fetuses.
